historical_reviews.deepseek: Recognizes both paths and expected 0x51 but does not provide a valid protected IB command, response-length/schema validation or evidence plan.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly treats this as a read-only standard query and replaces no-error-only acceptance with complete decoding and same-repository comparison.
historical_reviews.history: No earlier exact source identity record exists.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Get SDR Repository Info returns structured metadata, so a literal byte check without defining whether completion is included and whether 51 means hex is ambiguous. The response must be length-checked and decoded before comparing the two access paths.

original_test_intent: Read and compare SDR repository information through in-band and out-of-band IPMI on the same BMC, including the expected SDR version represented by source byte 2 as 0x51 under an explicit indexing convention.
original_method: Verify both paths resolve to one target, issue raw 0x0A/0x20 once per path, preserve complete responses, validate completion and exact schema, decode version/count/free space/timestamps/operation flags, compare results and prove no repository or log mutation occurred.
manual_activity: Package ownership is limited to validating the protected IB/OOB runners and SDR-info parser; ordinary execution needs no interactive confirmation, while the owner resolves unsupported or inconsistent metadata and sets the final verdict.
required_inputs: Proof IB and OOB address the same repository
Secret-safe IB and OOB command runner
Hexadecimal 0x51 version expectation or approved alternative
safety_requirements: Never clear logs or SDR records
Never treat operation flags as mutation authorization
Fail closed on target mismatch or malformed response
Preserve raw bytes with decoded fields
Bound to one request per path
Never retry automatically after ambiguous transport output
agent_execution_scope: Run one protected read per path
Archive no-mutation evidence and report without verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The OOB raw request matches the source, but the IB SSH payload lacks `ipmitool`, disables host-key verification and neither path validates the structured response.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use protected same-target IB and OOB runners for raw 0x0A/0x20, capture complete response bytes, validate schema, decode every field and compare snapshots without clearing evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The two read requests and 5/5-minute envelope are preserved; parsing, identity and no-clear controls replace the unsafe incomplete wrapper.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Produce paired raw and decoded records with target identity, completion, response length, SDR version, count, free space, add/erase timestamps and operation flags, followed by a field-level comparison.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds protected transport, explicit byte convention, full schema/endian validation and same-target proof while removing blanket log clearing.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No-error plus a bare byte cannot reveal truncated responses, endian errors, stale/mismatched targets or divergent repository metadata.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Counts or timestamps may legitimately change if another actor mutates the repository between reads; the package must record timing and report contention rather than force equality.

project_override_considerations: The Project may supply a vendor-specific version value or additional fields, but must explicitly map them to the standard response. It may not convert this read-only case into Reserve/Add/Delete/Clear SDR work.
expected_evidence: Verified target and IB/OOB same-repository proof
Protected raw requests and complete redacted responses
Field comparison, no-clear/no-mutation audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, procedure and criteria consistently target the same SDR-info read. The only ambiguity is byte indexing and representation, resolvable by explicit schema parsing without changing the objective.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The standard read request, parser and same-target checks are implementable. A specific run reports BLOCKED if either path or the response schema cannot be verified.

review_improvement: Converts a fragile literal-byte assertion into a complete, auditable dual-path repository metadata comparison without deleting diagnostic context.
independent_technical_reasoning: Depending on a runner's output format, displayed byte positions may exclude completion or include labels, and `51` may be mistaken for decimal rather than 0x51. Exact raw capture plus schema parsing removes that ambiguity. Because record count and timestamps can change under a competing writer, both reads must be close in time and mismatches reported with chronology rather than retried into apparent agreement.
